crossRefs.note: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

translations.web: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
translations.bsb: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.
translations.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
translations.asv: and Annas the high priest was there, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest.
